note: The answer key for tasks/seeded-review.mjs. Each case is one real commit's change to one file, rebuilt by build.mjs into cases/. A seeded case is a commit whose diff adds the lines of a defect later fixed on main; a control is a commit whose file no commit has touched since. Lines are 1-based, in the case's after file. Criticality was set on 2026-10-19, before any arm ran. A defect with `excluded` is kept for the record and not scored: the review on 2026-10-19, after the first run, found it is not visible in its case.

defects.description: A missing assertion-results.json is read as an empty list, so lhci exiting non-zero without assertion results scores "pass" with nothing checked.
defects.note: aa9a99268c moves these lines rather than writing them (they date from 8ffa8723); the diff still shows them as added.

defects.why_critical: Wrong numbers shipped to clients: consecutive reports both count the boundary day, inflating the headline Users figure.
defects.description: The next report's period starts ON the prior report's inclusive periodEnd, so the boundary day is counted in two consecutive reports.
defects.excluded: Not visible in r03: at d1218ac6 the report hard-codes gaUsersCurrent and gaUsersPrevious to 0 and runs no GA or Search query, so nothing in the change counts the boundary day twice; the double count became real only when a later commit wired GA in.

defects.description: branchTip treats only HTTP 404 as no branch; GitHub answers 422 "No commit found for SHA" for a branch that does not exist, so the call throws and the whole repo's audit becomes a probe failure.
The reply copy takes the first row whose form_type matches, so a blank row above the real one discards the CMS copy and the default reply is sent.

defects.why_critical: Security: a repoUrl starting with - (e.g. --upload-pack=...) is read by git as an option, which can run arbitrary commands.
defects.description: repoUrl is passed to git clone unvalidated and without a -- separator, so a value beginning with - is parsed as a git option.

defects.why_critical: Security: a site name such as ../escape or an absolute path lands the clone outside the configured workdir.
defects.description: site.name is joined onto workdir with no check for separators, .. segments or absolute paths.

defects.why_critical: Data corruption in a client's live CMS: uid is unique only per type, so an update can PUT one document's data onto a different-typed document.
defects.description: The update lookup is keyed by uid alone, but Prismic uids are unique per type, so two types sharing a uid collide and the PUT can target the wrong document.
Search Console can average a position below 0.5, which rounds to 0, so the client email renders "#0".
defects.note: Likely not reachable: Search Console average positions are 1-based, so never below 1; the fix floors at 1 as a guard, and no real "#0" is recorded. Every run missed it, so it moves no arm.

defects.description: An approved, unsent report's history row offers only Unapprove, so its preview cannot be refreshed without unapproving it.
defects.excluded: Not a defect r11 introduces: before 5f6ca41b an approved row had no action at all, this change adds Unapprove and removes nothing, and its own docstring sends a refresh through the pending list. The fix 47f1460d is a feat.
